title: Issue #209: [P1] Prove Aurora-to-chain vertical E2E through wallet, VM and finality
content:
State: open

## Goal
Produce one auditable vertical proof path from an Aurora task through policy, compute verification and authorized blockchain state change.

## Scope
Exercise the reference flow in the architecture specification using a non-critical test action and a controlled test environment.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Aurora task is correlated through task_id/run_id/agent_id/policy_version.
- [ ] Policy/capability check is enforced and denial/revocation cases fail closed.
- [ ] Required wallet approval/signature is separate from AI intent.
- [ ] Node validates the transaction and VM execution is deterministic for the same protocol inputs.
- [ ] Success is reported only after the defined finality condition; transaction ID and canonical-state evidence are recorded.
- [ ] Negative tests cover invalid signature, policy denial, timeout/retry and invalid/unverified worker result.
- [ ] All CI/E2E results cite exact tested SHAs for each participating repository and a reproducible run.

## Dependencies
Normative contracts; persistent Aurora lifecycle; multi-node worker path; independent result verification; chain test environment/finality contract.
